questions.stem_text:
Suppose the government has decided to combat inflation by raising taxes on disposable
income. What specific type of inflation would this be used against?

options.A: Central banks, investment banks, insurance companies
options.D: United States Treasury, Federal Reserve Banks, commercial banks

questions.stem_text: Which of the following will increase wages for tuba makers?

options.B: An increase in the number of graduates at tuba maker training school
options.C: An increase in the tax on tubas

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - An increase in the price of tubas
